resourceExperiments.label: Foundation resources
resourceExperiments.help: Makes gold ore, iron ore, silica and cotton available in the map editor. Existing maps and building costs are unchanged.

definitions.percent_denominator: All map tiles unless the field says otherwise; percentages are 0..100
definitions.distance: Eight-neighbor toroidal minimum cost between current ground-unit tile sets; ignores transient unit collisions, fog, diplomacy and orders
definitions.unreachable: null; diagonal colony distances are zero even without sources
definitions.resource_access: Minimum cost to a neighboring tile plus one; only deposits with positive stored amount count
definitions.resource_amount: Stored amount is a snapshot, not lifetime supply; eternal deposits are not finite stockpiles
definitions.components: Toroidal; terrain land/water are four-connected, resource patches and movement are eight-connected
definitions.canonical_quality: Production scoreStarts with the fitted fairness model, identical for every generator; uses its own ground-unit passability rule
definitions.quality_formula: fitness = model.intercept + sum of coefficient * transform(measurement) over model.terms; win_probability = softmax(fitness) over the map's colonies; fairness = score = 1 - Gini(win_probability) * n/(n-1)
definitions.percentiles: Linear interpolation at p*(count-1); stddev is population standard deviation
